tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background. Pure black in dark (OLED, matches the wordmark's black), pure white in light.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Top bar, bottom tab bar, mini player, side panels. One step off bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Cards, poster fallback tiles, menus, modals, input fields.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of surface-2 items, progress tracks, skeleton loaders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and chips. Holds 3:1 on bg through surface-3 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles and body copy on bg, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3 and hive-tint.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata lines (year, runtime, artist), descriptions. On bg through surface-3 and hive-tint.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, counts, placeholder text, disabled labels. On bg through surface-3.

tokens.name: hive
tokens.usage: THE brand red, exact from the logo (#970002). Primary button fill, active nav marker fill, the offset block behind a focused poster. It is the hidden HIVE layer: spend it on one thing per view. Carries on-hive text. Not for text or thin marks on dark grounds (2.3:1 on black).

tokens.name: hive-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of hive surfaces. Derived.

tokens.name: hive-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of hive surfaces. Derived.

tokens.name: hive-text
tokens.usage: Red text and thin red marks (links, active tab label, 'New' tags, playback progress) on bg through surface-3 and hive-tint. Brightened in dark so it holds 4.5:1; equals hive in light.

tokens.name: hive-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-row and active-chip background. Pair with ink or hive-text.

tokens.name: on-hive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on hive, hive-hover and hive-press fills (9:1 and up).

tokens.name: hive-mark
tokens.usage: Non-text red marks that need 3:1 on the ground: progress fill, unread dots, the active-tab underline. Resolves to hive-text in dark, hive in light.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and TV-remote focus ring: 2px solid at 2px offset, drawn on the ground around the element. White in dark, black in light.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success and 'available' states (download ready, request filled). Text on bg through surface-3. Kept on the blue side so it never pairs with red by hue alone; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings (transcoding, low storage, request pending). Text on bg through surface-3; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors. Shares the brand red, so it must always carry a word ('Delete', 'Failed') or an icon; never red alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and the full-screen player controls; also the bottom fade over backdrop art so ink stays legible.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero titles on the Home billboard and detail backdrop. Uppercase titles are fine here; set in ink over scrim.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles (Movies, Series, Music) on desktop.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Detail page title on mobile; modal titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, list-row titles, poster fallback titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: A young blade runner discovers a long-buried secret.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text, metadata lines, form fields.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasized inline text, active nav labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Under-poster metadata, timestamps, helper text. Use tabular numerals for times.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Tags and eyebrow labels. Always uppercase (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: tv-hero
styles.usage: 10-foot UI hero titles on the TV app.

styles.name: tv-body
styles.usage: TV metadata and body text. Nothing on TV is set smaller than this.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a poster and its caption; chip padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between posters in a rail on mobile; button padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; card padding; gap between posters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a rail header and its posters; button padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between rails.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section breaks on detail pages; TV rail gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: TV page gutter (10-foot safe area).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero billboard bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Posters, cards, backdrops, the top bar: square, like the wordmark.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, tags. Just enough to soften the pixel edge.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Menus, modals, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only for round things: avatars, the play-button disc, progress-bar ends, unread dots.

shadow.note: F7FIVE0 elevates with surfaces, not blur. The one signature shadow is the hard HIVE offset, lifted from the red layer sitting behind the black letters in the wordmark.

tokens.name: shadow-hive
tokens.usage: The HIVE offset: a hard red block behind a focused or hovered poster, the primary hero button, or the active nav item. One per view. Pair with the focus ring for keyboard/remote focus; the offset alone is not a focus indicator.

tokens.name: shadow-hive-s
tokens.usage: Small HIVE offset for buttons and chips.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, modals and the expanded queue panel.

tokens.name: poster-s
tokens.usage: Poster width in mobile rails (2:3 art).

tokens.name: poster-m
tokens.usage: Poster width in desktop rails and grids.

tokens.name: poster-l
tokens.usage: Poster width on detail pages and TV rails.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height, web.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, mobile (plus safe-area inset).

tokens.name: miniplayer-h
tokens.usage: Mini player height, docked above the tab bar.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on mobile and web.

tokens.name: focus-w
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; also the ring offset. TV uses 4px.
